claim_boundary: Static source-integrity evidence only. SHA-256 binds the editable per-part CadQuery source to its 47-part design-input contract; it does not assert CadQuery execution, native export, FCStd/STEP creation, manufacturing release, material/tolerance/sealing/thermal/EMC closure or vehicle readiness.

verification.update_rule: Update this manifest in the same reviewed change whenever its source or contract changes. Matching hashes never authorize CadQuery import or export.
